stem:
Parvez studies personal hygiene, menstrual hygiene, and disposal of used sanitary pads. He asks whether washing, wrapping used pads, and placing them in a dustbin protect both the body and the shared environment.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Washing, plus wrapping used pads before the dustbin, protects both the body and the shared environment.
An unwrapped used pad inside a dustbin is properly disposed of.
Only menstrual hygiene matters; everyday personal hygiene does not protect the body.
Skipping washing still protects the body if used pads are wrapped and placed in a dustbin.

teacher.key_rationale: Personal and menstrual hygiene protect the body; wrapping used pads before the dustbin also protects the shared environment. Skipping the wrap, dropping everyday washing, or treating pad disposal alone as full body protection are wrong.
